_notes: Configured from the live site (June 2026). Quirks: /products/ root 301s to an external subdomain, so plp.main is the Access Doors category; no Pro Club; quote form lives at /new-request-a-quote/; theme differs from BESTUS (footer-v2, .Info-box contact column, plain .breadcrumbs, no sidebar .categories-left, no related-products carousel, product form in #crmWebToEntityForm). Verified live July 2 2026: breadcrumbs carry a.breadcrumb-label (incl. Home) on PLP+PDP — breadcrumbHome/breadcrumbLabel filled; PLP pagination is AngularJS-rendered .ss-pagination-container > ul.pagination-list > li.pagination-item (active: .pagination-item--current, links: a.pagination-link, next: .pagination-item--next a, ?p=2) — plp.selectors.pagination filled; sort hash #/sort:searchspring_price:asc re-confirmed. LIGHTHOUSE: single fleet-wide LIGHTHOUSE_THRESHOLDS floor (performance 50, accessibility 60, seo 65) applied uniformly — per-store/per-page overrides removed July 2026; best-practices no longer asserted (dropped July 22 2026, platform-level/non-actionable). Live a11y scores homepage 83 / plp 73 / pdp 76 all clear the 60 floor. July 21 2026: dropped discovery.categories '/shop-by-size/access-doors-panels/' — it is a SearchSpring Angular 'shop by size' grid whose card images use ng-src/data-src lazyload with no src attr (visibility:hidden until scrolled), so assertProductCards' img-src check fails. Standard SS-template category pages (e.g. /products/access-doors/application/, /bilco/basement-door/) render .card-figure img with a resolved src and pass; kept those. KNOWN THEME BUG (verified July 27 2026): PDP theme calls jQuery.fancybox() before the lightbox plugin script has loaded (script-order/timing race) → 'jQuery(...).fancybox is not a function' TypeError at document-ready — a first-party theme bug (fires for real users on the same race), low-severity (product-gallery lightbox). Suppressed via a KNOWN_BUGGY_SCRIPTS messagePattern (/.fancybox is not a function/) in checks.js. ADAP devs must load the fancybox plugin before calling it. SEPT 29 2026 — two June 2026 absences turned out stale, both now enabled: (1) /architects/ carries a standard embedded Zoho form, ADAPArchitects2 (required: Name_First, Name_Last, Email, PhoneNumber_countrycode). Its City is plain text in SingleLine1 and there is no region field, so forms.architectInquiries sets cityField:'SingleLine1' / regionField:null (read by ArchitectFormPage); its _absentFeatures entry was removed. FSE's /architects/ iframes this same form, which looks like a copy-paste embed on FSE's side. (2) PDPs now emit a complete Product JSON-LD block (name, sku, description, image, offers with price/USD/InStock), so pdp.productJsonLd:false was removed and seo.cy.js's JSON-LD test runs. CHECKOUT (onboarded Sept 30 2026): checkout.product is /6-x-6-flush-access-door-with-concealed-latch-and-drywall-flange/ (product id 8481, SKU EDG-GYP-06-06, $76.43), priced, in stock, purchasable, 0 attribute[] inputs in the data-cart-item-add form, adding exactly 1 physical line item. Of the 20 products.known + pdp.popular slugs, 8 are option-free; this is the smallest parcel-sized one. ADAP's /checkout is the BESTUS page template running on the BESTCA checkout-js build: (a) activeStepClass is 'checkout-step--current', found by dumping every step container's className at each stage — no step ever carries 'active', and exactly one carries --current (shipping after sign-in, payment at the end); (b) customFields answers field_28 'Is this a construction site address?', which GET /api/storefront/form-fields reports as required:true, a radio with options.items [0:'Yes', 1:'No'] — the same field as BESTUS's field_36; (c) suppressAddressSwitchInlineErrors is true, because the template's inline jQuery click handler on the saved-address <li> items does console.log('Radio button clicked:', selected.value) at /checkout:707 with selected = the checked field_28 radio, which is null after 'Enter a new address' resets the form — the same defect as BESTUS's line 956, confirmed by reading the /checkout source (fetched with a throwaway anonymous cart, deleted afterwards). PRICING: the QA customer group zeroes the product (subtotal 0), and the account holds store credit, auto-applied ('Apply $19.74 store credit to order'): shipping 18.24 + tax 1.50 = grand 19.74, outstanding 0 — so storeCreditCheckbox keeps its default. 'Save this address in my address book' ships CHECKED (as on BESTCA), so ensureSaveAddressUnchecked() does real work; the address book held 10 entries across six runs. CONSOLE (triaged Sept 30 2026): consoleIgnore is []; /checkout logged no console.error beyond the Klaviyo default in two runs. RESOLVED SITE DEFECT (raised Sept 30 2026; fix confirmed live Oct 1 2026, when the checkout test passed): the same /checkout template carried the bug BESTCA fixed on Sept 23 2026 — function stopFunction2(){ stopFunction2(myVar2); } calls ITSELF instead of clearInterval(myVar2), twice (lines 508 and 605), so showTime2()'s 1-second setInterval throws RangeError: Maximum call stack size exceeded on the payment step, for the suite and for every real customer reaching it. Fix: replace the recursive call with clearInterval(myVar2) in both copies. With only that error suppressed locally (never committed) the whole funnel passes, including the server-side totals and address assertions, so the test goes green as soon as the template is fixed. The timer starts throwing right about when the test body finishes, so a given run sees it either in the body or during cleanup; checkout.cy.js's afterEach holds it until the carts are deleted and then re-raises it, so the run is red either way and never orphans a cart. FLAKE SEEN ONCE (in ~10 runs): 'Enter a new address' was found in the saved-address menu and then lost to a re-render before scrollIntoView ran; the retry passed that step.
